requires.for: local host/background execution and same-machine file access boundary
durable jobs/checkpoints, short authoritative transactions and typed persistence
Customer/Contact reference identity and deterministic reconciliation targets
SR/RFC/WFM domain identity, hierarchy and lifecycle commands

consumed_by.for: accepted WFM source-plan evidence and Task-plan conflict proposals

forbidden_dependencies: Adapters must not depend on UI components to establish domain validity.
Domain entities must not query raw workbook rows as current truth.
Import jobs must not depend on network availability.
Source checkpoints must not derive from Communication coverage state.
Domain lifecycle code must not interpret workbook omission as deletion authority.

lld_handoffs.scope: Advanced Search reconciliation surfaces that create/update Service Request facts
RFC/WFM discovery, parsing, staging, adoption, replay and review
